description: Source code implementing convolution operations for Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in PyTorch, including 2D and 3D convolutions, transposed convolutions, and their gradients.

classes.name: MPSCachedGraph
classes.description: Base class for caching MPS graph objects used in convolution operations.

methods.name: fill_conv3d_desc
methods.description: Creates and fills a 3D convolution descriptor with stride, dilation, padding, and group parameters.

methods.name: fill_depthwise_conv_desc
methods.description: Creates and fills a depthwise 3D convolution descriptor with stride, dilation, and padding.

methods.name: fill_conv_desc
methods.description: Creates and fills a 2D convolution descriptor with stride, dilation, padding, memory format, and groups.

methods.name: _mps_convolution_impl
methods.description: Core implementation of convolution operation, handling 2D and 3D convolutions with optional bias and input shape.

methods.name: _mps_convolution
methods.description: Wrapper for _mps_convolution_impl, performs convolution with given parameters.

methods.name: mps_convolution_backward_input
methods.description: Computes the gradient of the input tensor for convolution backward pass.

methods.name: mps_convolution_backward_weights
methods.description: Computes the gradient of the weight tensor for convolution backward pass.

methods.name: mps_convolution_backward
methods.description: Computes gradients for input, weight, and bias tensors during convolution backward pass.

methods.name: mps_convolution_transpose_forward
methods.description: Performs the forward pass of transposed convolution.

methods.name: _mps_convolution_transpose
methods.description: Wrapper for transposed convolution, with check for unsupported FP16/BF16 types.

methods.name: mps_convolution_transpose_backward_input
methods.description: Computes the gradient of the input tensor for transposed convolution backward pass.

methods.name: mps_convolution_transpose_backward_weight
methods.description: Computes the gradient of the weight tensor for transposed convolution backward pass.

methods.name: mps_convolution_transpose_backward
methods.description: Computes gradients for input and weight tensors during transposed convolution backward pass.
